d:
Bihar se dilli ja rahi ek niji esi (AC) slipar bas men us vakt harkanp mach gaya jab phajilangar (kushingar) ke mahuaa sthit koyalti petrol panp par tel bharvane ke dauran bas ki chhat se achanak dhuen ke sath aag ki lapten uthne lagin.
Bas ke esi koch ki chhat se aag aur dhuaan uthta dekh petrol panp par maujud logon aur rahgiron ne turant shor machana shuru kar diya. dekhte hi dekhte bas men savar yatriyon men chikh-pukar aur aphra-taphri mach gaee, aur log jan bachane ke lie bas se bahar bhagne lage.
